description: Shared cases of roles.json, the role definitions of docs/spec/agent-roles.md#role-definitions. The Go host and the Rust host run each read case against a roles.json holding `stored` (no file when `stored` is absent) and expect `result` or `error`; each write case passes `roles` to the write request on an absent file and expects `file` (the written document) or `error`, with the file still absent. `<file>` in an error stands for the path of roles.json. A `found` value is the compact JSON text of the format member, or null when the member is absent or the document is not an object. Each definition of format 3 has the members text, ko and files; a definition without files is refused.
